description: This file defines a custom Volley request class for handling multipart/form-data uploads, including text and file data, in an Android application.

classes.name: VolleyMultipartRequest
classes.description: A custom request class extending Volley Request to support multipart form data uploads, including text parameters and binary files.

classes.name: DataPart
classes.description: Inner class representing a data part with filename, content bytes, and optional content type for file uploads.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns request headers, defaulting to superclass headers if none are set.

methods.name: getBodyContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type for multipart/form-data with boundary.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Constructs and returns the byte array of the multipart request body, including text and file data.

methods.name: getByteData
methods.description: Placeholder method for subclasses to provide byte data parts; returns null by default.

methods.name: parseNetworkResponse
methods.description: Parses network response into a Volley Response object.

methods.name: deliverResponse
methods.description: Delivers the response to the registered listener.

methods.name: deliverError
methods.description: Delivers an error to the error listener.

methods.name: textParse
methods.description: Writes text parameters into the DataOutputStream as part of multipart data.

methods.name: dataParse
methods.description: Writes file data parts into the DataOutputStream.

methods.name: buildTextPart
methods.description: Writes a text parameter as a part of multipart data.

methods.name: buildDataPart
methods.description: Writes a file data part into the multipart request body.
